race.description: Celebrating Liam O'connor 4yo Westbred Mares Classic (G2)
race.comment: Smart mare FAKENIT (3) ended her last campaign in good form, last seen when winning a G3 here in June. Yet to miss a place when fresh so expect her to be wound up and she strikes at 50 per cent at this circuit and distance. Looks well placed and a good draw sees her as the one to beat. REINETTE (7) made an encouraging return from one spot wider, beaten just over a metre into second at this venue. This is stronger but she may be better for the hitout. WAVE REBELLION (10) finished off her last prep with back-to-back placings, one in a G3 behind FAKENIT and the other from this barrier. Proven fresh so look for a good return. ITS MAA TIME (11) cops a similar draw to what she had in her resuming fourth but she is proven second-up so may progress.
